title: The Casimir Effect
description: Two plates in a vacuum attract: empty space is full of energy. Unlocks the Casimir Press and Zero-Point Extractor.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the attractive Casimir force between two parallel plates of area A at separation a.

title: Quantum Entanglement
description: Spooky action at a distance, put to work. Unlocks qubits and the Quantum Entangler.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the probability that two polarisation-entangled photons in the state |Φ+> give the same result when the two polarisers are set at an angle θ to each other.

title: Metamaterials
description: Engineered structures with a negative refractive index.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the refractive index of a double-negative metamaterial whose relative permittivity is -4 and relative permeability is -1 (enter the magnitudes; the negative root is taken).

title: Thermodynamics of Information
description: Information is physical. A demon that knows which molecules are fast can sort them and reverse entropy.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the Landauer minimum energy to erase one bit at T = 300 K, expressed in units of kB (so the answer is in kelvin).

title: Genomics
description: Four letters, three billion of them. Unlocks the Gene Sequencer, recombinant DNA and engineered enzymes.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the sequencing coverage (Lander-Waterman) of a human genome sequenced with N reads of length L.

title: Nanochemistry
description: Carbon one atom thick, rolled, folded and caged. Unlocks graphene, nanotubes and buckyballs.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the diameter (nm) of a (10,10) armchair carbon nanotube, with graphene lattice constant a = 0.246 nm.

title: Annihilation Power
description: Matter plus antimatter equals pure energy. Dilithium keeps it from equalling a crater.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the energy released when 1 μg of antimatter annihilates with the same mass of matter in a reactor of efficiency η.

title: Neutrino Physics
description: Ghost particles, trillions of which pass through you every second.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the oscillation length (km) of a 1 GeV neutrino with mass-squared splitting 0.0025 eV^2.

title: Brane Cosmology
description: Our universe is a membrane floating in the Bulk. The Brane Shifter can take you there.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the Randall-Sundrum warp factor that suppresses energies on our brane relative to the hidden brane.

title: Hyperdimensional Geometry
description: Tesseracts and Calabi-Yau manifolds: geometry beyond three dimensions.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the hypervolume of a 4-dimensional ball of radius r.

title: Real Analysis
description: Limits, continuity and the completion of the rationals into the reals. Unlocks the Analytic Continuator.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the limit of the geometric series a + ar + ar² + ... (for |r| < 1).

title: Stellar Evolution
description: Stars are born from nebulae, live on the main sequence, swell into giants and die. Unlocks the Nucleosynthesis Chamber.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the main-sequence lifetime of a star of mass M (in solar masses).

title: Antiatoms
description: An antiproton and a positron make antihydrogen - with exactly the same spectrum as hydrogen. Unlocks the Antiproton Decelerator.

old_puzzle.goal: CPT says antihydrogen has exactly the spectrum of hydrogen. Find the energy of its n-th level in eV, with R the Rydberg energy.

title: Component Tiers
description: Better coils run hotter and unlock heavier recipes; better field emitters let a multiblock run more parallels. A structure is only as good as its weakest part.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the survival probability of a structure of N = 10 parts under stress σ = 0.5 (in units of the characteristic part strength) when the Weibull modulus is m = 3.

title: Research Synthesis
description: Teach a machine to study. Unlocks the Research Nexus and Empirical Dossiers; later dossiers come with later research.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the time a learning machine needs for its n-th study task under a power-law learning curve (Wright's law).

title: Dyson Sphere
description: Close the swarm into a shell and capture a star's entire output.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the equilibrium temperature (K) of a Dyson shell at r = 0.7 AU around a star of L = 0.5 solar luminosities, radiating only outward.

title: The Holographic Principle
description: Everything inside a volume is encoded on its boundary - black holes included.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the Bekenstein-Hawking entropy (in bits of kB) of a black hole of horizon radius r, which is a quarter of its area in Planck units.

title: Synthetic Biology
description: Write life instead of reading it. Unlocks synthetic cells, xenobots and stem cell cultures.

old_puzzle.goal: Find how many synthetic cells a culture holds after time t if it starts from N0 cells that divide every td hours.

title: Morphogenesis
description: How a blob of identical cells paints itself into a body: reaction and diffusion. Unlocks Turing morphogens.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the relative morphogen concentration C/C0 at x = 50 µm from the source, with D = 10 µm^2/s and degradation rate k = 0.001 /s.

title: Quantum Field Theory
description: Particles are excitations of fields. Wave packets, spinors, field lattices and Feynman diagrams.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the energy of a field excitation (particle) of mass m and wavenumber k, in units with ħ = c = 1.

title: Room-Temperature Superconductivity
description: Cooper pairs that hold together at room temperature, inside a hydrogen-rich framework.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the BCS critical temperature of a hydride superconductor from its Debye temperature and electron-phonon coupling.

title: General Relativity
description: Gravity is the curvature of spacetime. Metrics, curvature and Einstein's field equations.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the Schwarzschild radius (m) of the Sun, mass 1.989e30 kg.

title: The Island of Stability
description: Past the end of the periodic table, magic numbers promise superheavy nuclei that last. Unlocks the Nuclide Forge.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the liquid-drop fissility of flerovium-298 (Z = 114, A = 298) with surface coefficient 17.8 MeV and Coulomb coefficient 0.711 MeV.

title: Matrioshka Brain
description: Wrap a star in nested shells of computronium and let it think.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the equilibrium temperature of the outermost Matrioshka shell (area A = 4πR² at 1 AU) around a star of luminosity L, which sets the Landauer cost per bit of the whole brain.

title: Horizon Simulation
description: A black hole is the densest possible computer. Feed it a star and it will simulate one. Unlocks the Eye of the Event Horizon.

old_puzzle.goal: Find how many bits a black hole of horizon radius r can store (Bekenstein-Hawking entropy), with r and the Planck length l in the same units.

title: Transfinite Mathematics
description: Cantor proved that some infinities are bigger than others. Build them. Unlocks the Cantor Diagonalizer.

old_puzzle.goal: Show how many more subsets the power set of the power set of a 3-element set has than the power set itself (Cantor: each step is strictly bigger).

title: Conceptual Singularities
description: Compress an entire field of knowledge into one point. Unlocks the Conceptual Singularity Compressor.

old_puzzle.goal: Find the minimum number of bits needed to compress a message of N symbols drawn uniformly from an alphabet of k symbols (Shannon source coding).

title: Hyperdimensional Reality
description: The space outside every universe, where universes grow on a tree and laws are born from an ocean.

old_puzzle.goal: Find how many universes the cosmic tree holds if every universe buds b daughters, down to depth d.
